ghostBuyer.title: The 'Ghost' Buyer
ghostBuyer.situation: Someone asks about 'apartments in Marbella' with just an email.
ghostBuyer.without: Send a generic email. No response.
ghostBuyer.with: You see they spent time on 2-bedroom units in Puerto Banús (¬300k-¬400k range) and viewed financing options. You reply with three highly specific, matching properties.
ghostBuyer.result: They respond in 2 hours. You book viewings and close in 10 days.

comparisonShopper.title: The Comparison Shopper
comparisonShopper.situation: A lead contacts you, but you know they're talking to 5 other agents.
comparisonShopper.without: You drop your commission to try and secure the deal.
comparisonShopper.with: Analytics show they are price-sensitive and frequently check price drops. You focus entirely on the lowest price per m² and ROI.
comparisonShopper.result: You win the deal by being a trusted advisor, not the cheapest agent.

sleepyListing.title: The Sleepy Listing
sleepyListing.situation: A property sits for 60 days. The seller is frustrated.
sleepyListing.without: You blame the slow market and risk losing the listing.
sleepyListing.with: Data shows 1,200 views but 80% left after seeing the price. Similar homes sold 8% lower.
sleepyListing.result: You present cold, hard data. Seller agrees to a small price drop. Property sells within 2 weeks.
